title: Pan-Seared British Asparagus with Garlic
description: A simple and healthy side dish that showcases the freshness of British asparagus, pan-seared to perfection with garlic.
instructions: 1. Rinse the asparagus under cold water and pat dry with a paper towel.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
4. Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. If desired, squeeze a tablespoon of lemon juice over the asparagus.
